title: not good
text:
not good. I know this company, and I was expecting quality, this was dissappointing. I'm sending it back, I would not display this piece anywhere in my home. It looks that bad. nothing life like here. leaves, lemons etc. just cheap.
I would expect to find this at the dollar store, not vickermans.

product_metadata.title: Vickerman Everyday 28" Artificial Potted Lemon Tree - Lifelike Home Or Office Decor - Premium Faux Potted Tree with Real Touch Leaves - Maintenance Free
features: [Real Touch Leaves] -- Add a Beautiful Accent to any room decor with this lemon tree which features real-touch leaves designed to feel like the real thing.

[Potted Tree] -- This faux Lemon Tree is planted in a black planters pot that can stand on its own or be easily inserted into the decorative container of your choice. This pot allows the owner to easily redecorate their home; simply move the tree from one pot to another.

[Plant Dimensions] -- This Lemon Tree is 28"H x 12"W x 12"D. The planters pot measures 5"L x 5"W x 4.5"H and fits easily into any larger container. The size of this tree makes it perfect for tying together any living room.

[Natural looking greenery] -- This artificial potted plant creates the appearance of a live tree with highly detailed leaves on multiple stems. It features varying size foliage, rich texture, and precise details to create a realistic look. Replicate a real Lemon Tree with this truly lifelike item.

[Maintenance Free] -- Want to keep your plants green year-round with no effort? Don't ever worry about watering, simply dust the leaves when necessary. This plant is made from durable polyester material and will maintain its color and shape forever.
description: Vickerman 28" Real Touch Artificial Lemon Tree. The Vickerman 28-inch Tall Potted Faux Lemon Tree is made to look just like a natural lemon tree. With its realistic leaves and fruit, this large faux tree is sure to bring a touch of nature into your home. Featuring vivid yellow lemons and verdant leaves, this faux lemon tree plant adds a pop of color and texture to any space. Perfect for indoor use, this maintenance-free faux lemon tree is easy to keep looking fresh with just a quick wipe of a dry cloth. Whether you're looking for a tall faux indoor plant or an artificial floor plant, this faux indoor tree is sure to add a touch of greenery to your home or office decor.

details.Material: Polyethylene, Cement, Iron, Ethylene Vinyl Acetate
